string.text: Moonshine Distiller

A heavy-duty post-apocalyptic distillation apparatus assembled from a 40L Soviet aluminum milk can, an electric 2-burner hotplate, an aroma thumper jar with blue electrical tape, and a metal cooling drum with internal copper worm coils. Placed in a settlement, it serves as the dedicated primary workstation for camp Brewers, boosting distillation efficiency and producing high-proof vodka rations and medical alcohol.
%s is operating the moonshine distiller, yielding a rich batch of vodka (%d bottles)!
Ammunition Crafting Bench

An industrial heavy steel reloading workbench equipped with a single-stage cast iron reloading press, mechanical balance powder scale, powder dispenser hopper, and gunsmith vise. In a settlement, it serves as the dedicated primary workstation for camp Crafters, boosting round production yield and reducing scrap metal waste.
%s is working at the ammunition crafting bench, pressing and packaging a fresh batch of %s!
Woodcutter's Sawbuck & Charcoal Kiln

A comprehensive forestry workstation combining an X-frame timber sawbuck with a two-man crosscut saw, an oak splitting stump with an embedded felling axe, stacked split firewood, and a charred carbon-steel retort kiln with a brick hearth and flue chimney. In a settlement, it serves as the dedicated primary workstation for camp Woodcutters, significantly boosting timber output, yielding charcoal lumps for cooking and gunpowder manufacturing, and eliminating kindling bottlenecks.
%s is hard at work at the woodcutter station, splitting fresh firewood logs and burning a fresh batch of charcoal (%d bags)!
Battery Charging & Generator Relay Station

An integrated electrical hub built on a welded angle-iron workstation. Features a portable Soviet 4-stroke gasoline generator with recoil starter, an overhead distribution and relay panel with analog voltmeters, ammeters, and a ceramic knife switch, a heavy lower battery bank for lead-acid accumulators, and a multi-slot desktop quick-charger for rechargeable battery packs. In a settlement, it serves as the dedicated primary workstation for Electricians, enabling full recharging of dead battery packs (batteries) and military cells, maintaining perimeter lighting, and power-cycling camp electronics.
%s has completed an electrical maintenance cycle at the generator station, recharging dead battery packs (%d charged) and tuning settlement power relays!
Gunsmith & Armor Repair Bench

A heavy-duty industrial workstation crafted from thick scarred steel plate and reinforced tubular framing, dedicated to field maintenance of weapons and protective equipment. Equipped with a heavy bench vise with padded clamping jaws holding rifles for servicing, an organized parts tray, cleaning rods, lubricants, and solvents, alongside a dedicated armor repair section with ballistic strike plates, textile repair patches, and hand-riveting tools. A vertical backboard displays technical weapon schematics, technical notes, tool racks, and an illuminated task lamp. In a settlement, it serves as the master workstation for Technicians, boosting repair efficiency by 50%, reducing repair kit part costs, and passively maintaining weapons stored in camp.
%s has serviced camp gear at the repair bench, tuning internal mechanisms and restoring condition on %s (%s%%)!
%s completed a routine maintenance inspection at the repair bench, field-stripping and lubricating camp weapons!
Hunter's Butchering & Tanning Station

A rugged timber processing station constructed from scavenged heavy pine logs with overlapping bolted lap joints, forged iron reinforcing brackets, and a heavy hanging gambrel carcass rack with pulley and steel hooks. Features an ergonomic convex skinning and fleshing beam equipped with a two-handed draw scraper and dual-grit whetstones, two pegged rectangular hide-stretching frames with laced mutant pelts, coopered wooden salt barrels with iron hoops and coarse preservation salt, a tool rack with hunting blades, and a field pack with lantern. In a settlement, it serves as the master workstation for Hunters, significantly increasing mutant meat harvest yields, preserving pristine mutant pelts (flesh, boar, pseudodog), and maximizing trophy harvesting efficiency.
%s processed harvested mutant game at the tanning and butchering station, yielding %s, cured pelts, and hunting trophies!
Farmer's Raised Beds & Field Oven

A frontier farm plot built from salvaged planks and crates: a raised bed of potato plants, a bed of ripening wheat, a work crate with a bucket and tools, sacks of produce, a wooden fence and a brick field oven with a chimney. In a settlement, it serves as the dedicated workstation for camp Farmers, doubling the harvest of potatoes for the still and grain for the oven, and baking bread right in the field.
Potatoes
Fresh potatoes dug from a settlement farm. Filling when eaten, and the Brewer's favourite mash for distilling vodka.
Wheat Grain
A sack of threshed wheat from a settlement farm. A Farmer mills it and bakes it into bread at a Farmer Station or a stove.
%s dug a rich potato harvest from the raised beds (%d potatoes)!
%s milled the grain and baked fresh loaves in the field oven (%d bread)!
Roadside Market Stall

A rickety Zone market stall: a plank counter under a patched tarp awning, crates and sacks of wares, tins, bottles and a barrel. Stalkers drop goods into it and the settlement Trader sells them. Talk to the Trader to collect the takings. Players can only sell through it. It will not sell anything back.
Water Purifier

A gravity-fed water purifier on a concrete pad. Groundwater is drawn up the intake pipe, settles in the drum and runs through carbon filter cartridges, so it comes out clean of the radiation that soaks the soil. It counts as a settlement water purifier: with charcoal or paper filters in camp storage, your settlers fill clean flasks of water every few hours. Weighs 10 kg to carry.
